blocks.title: Damped oscillations
blocks.text: Woh oscillations jin ka amplitude mazahmati quwwaton ki wajah se ghatta hai damped oscillations kehlati hain, aur mazahmati quwwatein damping forces kehlati hain.

Misali free oscillation mein kul mechanical tawanai constant rehti hai, jaise mass-spring nizam, daire mein ghoomta jism aur simple pendulum. Amalan hawa ki mazahmat aur ragar jaisi tawanai zaya karne wali quwwatein amal karti hain, is liye amplitude waqt ke saath ahista ahista ghatta aur jism aakhir ruk jata hai. Maslan jhoole par larki chhote se chhote amplitude se jhoolti aur aakhir ruk jati hai (Fig 14.14, kitab mein khaaka); damped oscillation graph par Fig 14.15 mein dikhayi gayi hai. Ahista ruka pendulum, aur ungli se chhua thartharata tuning fork bhi misalein hain.

items: Halki damping: tawanai aur amplitude ahista ahista ghatte hain; jism rukne se pehle kai dafa jhoolta hai. Khel ke maidan ka jhoola achhi misal hai.
Bhari damping: jism jhoolta nahi aur rest tak wapas aane mein der lagata hai, maslan garhe tel mein pendulum.
Critical damping: jism jhoole baghair kam se kam waqt mein apni tawazun ki jagah par wapas aa jata hai, maslan gari ke shock absorbers.

blocks.alt: Oopar: damped oscillation; neela curve waqt ke mehwar ke gird jhoolta, chotiyan dashed lifafe ke andar chhoti hoti. Neeche: chhorne ke baad teen suraton mein waqt ke muqable displacement: halki damping (neela) ahista ghatte jhoolon ke saath; critical damping (sabz) sifar tak sab se jaldi, use paar kiye baghair; bhari damping (surkh) jhoole baghair ahista sifar ki taraf. Note: gari ke shock absorbers critical damping ke qareeb banaye jate hain.
blocks.caption: Damped oscillations aur halki, critical aur bhari damping (asal graphs; oopar wala Fig 14.15 ke mutabiq).
blocks.long_description: Damping oscillation se tawanai nikalti hai. Bohat kam damping jism ko uchhalta chhor deti; bohat zyada use ahista ahista wapas lati; critical damping use kam se kam waqt mein rest par lati hai.

blocks.text: Gari ke suspension nizam ke shock absorbers (kitab ki Fig 14.16 gari ke suspension ki tasveer hai) damping ka amali istemal hain. Ubhar-khabar, kharab sarak par aaramdeh safar ke liye damping zaruri hai: is ke baghair gari har jhatke ke baad uchhalti rehti. Critical damping behtareen hai, kyunke gari ka dhancha jhoole baghair kam se kam waqt mein apni aam satah par wapas aa jata hai; halki damping mein yeh der tak uchhalti, aur bhari damping mein ahista wapas aati aur suspension agla jhatka jazb na kar pata.

blocks.prompt: Gari ke suspension nizam mein critical damping kyun pasand ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh gari ke dhanche ko jhoole baghair kam se kam waqt mein tawazun ki jagah par le aati hai, is liye safar hamwar hota aur suspension agle jhatke ke liye tayyar rehta hai.

items: Halki (jhoolta), critical (sab se jaldi wapsi, jhoolna nahi), bhari (ahista wapsi).
Gari ke shock absorbers: critical damping ke qareeb.
